svg.aria-label: Config in Git, state from the API: 1. Config: ConfigMap homepage-config mounts six YAML files at /app/config: bookmarks, services, settings, widgets, docker and kubernetes. 2. Secrets: ExternalSecret homepage-secret pulls the unifi, nas and grafana items from 1Password into the pod environment. 3. Discover: ClusterRole homepage lets the pod read namespaces, pods, nodes, HTTPRoutes and metrics. Route annotations add the tiles. 4. Render: The app serves the dashboard on port 3000 through the envoy-internal HTTPRoute, with the ServiceAccount token mounted for the cluster widgets.
